name: LD2450 Sensor
description: The `ld2450` component allows you to use the [HLK-LD2450](https://www.hlktech.net/index.php?id=1157) human presence, motion detection and tracking radar module with ESPHome.

config_entries.label: UART ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart) to use. Required if you have multiple UARTs configured.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for this [Ld2450](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2450/) component.

config_entries.label: Link Timeout
config_entries.description: How long the radar can send no valid data frame before the component reports that the link to the radar is lost. Range is `1s` to `1h`. Defaults to `5s`. See [When the Radar Stops Sending](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2450/#when-the-radar-stops-sending). A long value only delays the detection. It does not turn it off: after `1h` without a frame the link is still reported lost.
